contract: An original worker schedules an unmarked activity at command sequence 1 and exits before the declared checkpoint can be advanced by a replacement. A separate cold PHP process inserts the same patched() ID twice before that original activity. Both calls choose false without consuming or shifting the original command; no new activity or version marker is committed. Finish the same original activity and run with one typed outcome, preserving all checkpoint events and durable IDs. Embedded mode uses separate original/replacement author definitions under the same registered type and actual queue jobs. This explicitly selected pending fixture is a PHP SDK/embedded deployment control, not yet Python/Rust SDK or published-successor qualification. Existing Python duplicate-marker histories are a separate compatibility case under SDK Python #103 and SDK Rust #80.
